0022600143.text: The Clippers (1-2, 1-0 at home, 0-2 on the road) are third in the Pacific and 10th in the West, and they have lost two straight in their fourth game of the 2026-27 season. They host the Lakers (3-0), who lead the Pacific and the West and have won three straight. Out for the Clippers are Bradley Beal (knee, inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (foot, plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery), while the Lakers are without Adou Thiero (knee, inflammation). The Clippers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 125-117 loss in Los Angeles on October 23, and the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26.
